_doc: Somebody lying shot again keeps the one body (Prender-278): at the street corner at (60, 8) a level round at the legs of the walker nearest knocks them down, a second takes a leg off as they lie and a third strikes them lying again ({legRound}: LookArgs); then one body lies there, its leg thrown beside it, no second body over or under it (the census lists the walker once). Near (110 px a metre) from 0, 90, 180 and 270 degrees at 35, at street level (8 degrees) and from above (80); mid (40, at 45) and far (12, at 60) from 90 degrees, the side the corner's railings and towers leave open; with the clock running, the walkers round it moving.
